About OurSolver

Simple tools for the files that get in your way.

OurSolver is an independent collection of browser-based image and PDF utilities. Its purpose is simple: help you finish a file task without creating an account or sending your document away for processing.

Useful by design

The collection handles everyday jobs: resizing, compressing, converting, cropping, combining, creating PDFs, and formatting photos for visas and portals. Each tool states its limits and gives you a downloadable result.

A small, honest project

OurSolver does not present invented employees, customer testimonials or usage statistics. The artwork is an original AI-assisted illustration, not a photograph of a real team. Tools use browser APIs and the open-source pdf-lib library.

Keep the original

File conversion can change quality, metadata and document features. Always keep the source and inspect the result. Visit our help page for supported formats and troubleshooting.
